matchedRules.reason: Current OS Trace gateway and Trace Burn changes must prove authenticated history paging, canonical TraceStore resolution, safe redaction, and OS-owned virtual-list/browser behavior.

These tests share process.env and local MCP daemons, so files run serially to prevent cross-file agent-verification interference.
Session constructor, canonical guidance, task-start compatibility, and workspace fallback changes must prove the integrated task/work session contract.
